allocations.note: Typed buffer byte lengths are measured JS retained backing stores. PNG/video decoded storage and GPU texture byte totals are arithmetic estimates. OS RSS/PSS are CPU resident memory including SwiftShader; they are not physical GPU VRAM. Arrival-only HDR uniforms and renderer-internal LUT/depth may not all be enumerated here. The morph texture estimate uses the local Three 0.186.1 WebGLMorphtargets.js layout; it is an arithmetic upper bound if some geometry was never drawn. Its internal Float32Array is excluded from the directly enumerated GI/image retained buffers.
